protocol.common_method: C local recovery + paired cosine fusion margin0.1

base.scope: All future CLUE 10-5 incremental runs use this step0 unless user explicitly changes it; other task splits require matching future-background0 step0.

protocol.loss: CLS + 0.2 original PTC + 0.1 original SEG + 0.1 C correction + 0.1 fusion correction + 0.1 KD

kd.channels: old foreground only, excluding background and new channels
kd.distance: sum of Bernoulli KL across old foreground channels, times T squared
kd.normalization: same valid nonignore pixel denominator for both variants (rank-local, same as baseline SEG)
kd.evidence: old teacher foreground, sigmoid winning logit >=0.75 and classifier cosine>=0; no refined new candidate OR cosine conflict resolved to old by margin0.1; exclude C recovered and new-strong/ambiguous conflict pixels

protocol.checkpoint_policy: only final checkpoint of each stage; retain until later stages and all analysis complete; never delete canonical step0; archive metrics/hashes before deleting inferior run weights
analysis: stage1 and stage2 old/new/initial/incremental per-class IoU
all-active-batch KD coverage, protected/new/unresolved and conflict counts
paired final predictions and old-to-new/new-to-old errors
paired image bootstrap 95% CI (evaluation sampling only, not seed variance)
limitations: selective KD reduces total distillation mass; no matched-mass control in this two-variant experiment
A800 no-KD result is a historical context reference; different GPU/runtime cannot prove net KD gain
evaluation labels never enter incremental training or mask selection

1.scope: Frozen final models on deterministic held-out subset, original-aspect images; not training-time accuracy
1.input_tags: Existing image-level labels; no pixel GT input to candidate selection
1.coarse_teacher_semantics: For the old teacher, current newly introduced GT classes map to its background category. Coarse accuracy and full expanded-label accuracy describe different label spaces; channel diagnostics separately check binary relations.
1.selected_group_definition: Evidence-protection mask in both variants; plain KD actually uses eligible pixels.

old_channel_diagnostic.probability: Sigmoid of raw teacher old-foreground logits, matching confidence gating; training KD temperature is separate
old_channel_diagnostic.interpretation: Teacher category BG on new GT can still provide correct old-class absence signals; GT is used only in this offline diagnostic.

pre_kd_step1.timing: Before the first active KD/C/F update
pre_kd_step1.limitation: A difference exists before KD activation; single-run final deltas do not isolate the causal effect of the mask. Do not subtract this scalar baseline difference and claim a corrected causal effect.

pre_kd_step2.timing: Before first active KD/C/F update in this stage; each variant inherits its own final step1 teacher
pre_kd_step2.limitation: Step2 initial state includes prior-stage KD effects and training variability; this is not a KD-free causal control.

densecrf_extra.scope: 1449 held-out images; same averaged logits before/after DenseCRF; fixed parameters

selection: Plain KD has higher final overall single-scale and five-scale-flip mIoU and less old-region forgetting. Keep plain final chain and best evidence step1; current strict foreground-only gate is not recommended as the default.
diagnostic_limits: Frozen final models on 128 deterministic held-out images per stage, not online training-time accuracy.
Correct negative-channel signs are common due to class imbalance; sign consistency does not prove useful gradients.
Selective KD changes locations and drastically reduces KD mass; no matched-mass control.
One training seed. Paired image bootstrap is evaluation-sample uncertainty, not seed variability.
Differences already exist before step1 KD activation. Historical A800/no-KD results do not provide a same-runtime causal control.
